plan.major: Para Professional Interior Planning and Design Certificate
plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Para Professional Interior Planning and Design Certificate (Part Time, Fall Start)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 14, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7424/PublishedPdf). Total Units 39.5 = 12+12+9+6.5 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). This map shows the fastest way to complete this program; it can be started in the spring as well. Scheduling: IDES 110, 310, 324, and 332 are offered in the fall; IDES 312, 334, 350, and 351 are offered in the spring. An internship (WEXP 498) is required as it opens up potential employment opportunities; students can earn at least 0.5 units for related paid or unpaid work experience, including volunteer and internship positions. By the end of the third semester, students qualify for the Interior Retail Merchandising certificate.
